photos/lissajous.svg.title: Lissajous, 3:2
photos/lissajous.svg.description: Three phases of the curve x = sin 3t, y = sin 2t, drawn with a single parametric rule. The red point is the origin of the parameter.

photos/harmonograph.svg.title: A Damped Harmonograph
photos/harmonograph.svg.description: What a harmonograph draws when the paper is allowed to keep moving after the hand has stopped: a family of curves decaying toward the centre.

photos/rose-curve.svg.title: Rose, Fourteen Petals
photos/rose-curve.svg.description: The polar curve r = cos(7θ/3), with two faint rotations behind it. Fourteen petals, no two of them quite the same distance from the eye.

photos/phyllotaxis.svg.title: Phyllotaxis, Golden Angle
photos/phyllotaxis.svg.description: One thousand and one hundred seeds placed at successive multiples of 137.507 degrees. The marked seeds are every eighty-ninth, for no reason except that it is beautiful.

photos/da-lat-mist.svg.title: Mist over Đà Lạt
photos/da-lat-mist.svg.description: Drawn from memory the morning after the rain. The contour lines are approximate; the fog is not.

documents/basel-notes.pdf.title: Notes on the Basel Problem
documents/basel-notes.pdf.description: Two pages of working notes: the sine product, the coefficient comparison, and the small matter of rigour that Euler left for Weierstrass.

documents/winter-reading-list.pdf.title: A Reading List for Winter
documents/winter-reading-list.pdf.description: Six books, one notebook, and no particular hurry. Filed under reading, not under resolutions.
